from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess

root = Path('/tmp/skill-trial-runs/code-reviewer-25')
evidence = root / 'evidence'
checks = [
    ('node-version', ['node', '--version'], root),
    ('full-diff', ['diff', '-ru', 'before', 'after'], root / 'case'),
    ('before-tests', ['node', '--test', 'test/card.test.mjs'], root / 'case/before'),
    ('after-tests', ['node', '--test', 'test/card.test.mjs'], root / 'case/after'),
    ('contract-repro', ['node', '--test', 'repro.test.mjs'], evidence),
]
records = []
for name, command, cwd in checks:
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True)
    (evidence / f'{name}.stdout.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    (evidence / f'{name}.stderr.txt').write_bytes(result.stderr)
    (evidence / f'{name}.exit-code.txt').write_text(str(result.returncode) + '\n')
    record = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': result.returncode}
    records.append(record)
    print(json.dumps(record))
    print(result.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), end='')
    print(result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'), end='')
(evidence / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

root = Path('/tmp/skill-trial-runs/code-reviewer-25/case')
evidence = Path('/tmp/skill-trial-runs/code-reviewer-25/evidence')
start = json.loads((evidence / 'snapshot-start.json').read_text())
manifest = {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
encoded = json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
end = {'root': str(root), 'algorithm': start['algorithm'], 'snapshot': hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(), 'files': manifest}
(evidence / 'snapshot-end.json').write_text(json.dumps(end, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'start': start['snapshot'], 'end': end['snapshot'], 'unchanged': start == end}))
assert start == end, 'Reviewed case changed during review'
